mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity and noradrenergic neurotransmission, creating additive CNS effects and risk of serotonin syndrome; tramadol is metabolized by CYP2D6 which atomoxetine inhibits, increasing tramadol levels.
action: Use combination cautiously with close monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, tremor, hyperthermia); consider alternative analgesic or reduce tramadol dose; avoid in patients with seizure history.
